transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Honestly, I've just been feeling incredibly down and depressed for the last nine months, and I can't seem to shake it. It feels like I'm completely empty inside and I just don't have the strength to do anything anymore.
Have you felt depressed or down like this most days for at least two years, or has this been a much shorter period with a more recent start?
No, it definitely hasn't been going on for two years. This current period of feeling so down and depressed has been going on for about nine months now.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Yes, completely. I've lost all interest in the hobbies and activities I used to love, and nothing brings me any joy anymore. I just can't seem to experience any happiness or pleasure from anything lately.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself, and I don't feel like life isn't worth living. But I still feel incredibly down and completely empty inside every single day.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep or appetite since this started?
No, I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep or appetite since this started. Everything in those areas has stayed pretty much the same.
